How the candidate was made

Each new pose reuses one adjacent anchor's painting. Independently translated shoes follow midpoint landmarks at unit scale. Two lower-petal panels overlap as the stance narrows; a local arm mesh and at most 1 px of body rise bridge the endpoints. Faces and accessories are never regenerated. Shoes are not recolored, resized or sheared. Subpixel resampling can soften edges. There is no optical-flow calculation or averaging of two frames. Hidden gait mechanics cannot be reconstructed or certified from these sprites alone.
